title: Would a white bandleader have gotten further?
summary: He says doors, hotels and films would have opened sooner, but things are better now.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Are there any things that you believe might have been different if you had been a white band leader? Or, if the situation had been reversed, or if the circumstances didn't exist as they were? Or, put another way, do you think that you were, that you lost some things because you were black band leader?

Well, during that time, of course, we didn't have the chance the white band leaders did. I couldn't have maybe been a little farther ahead. You know? I could, a few more doors could have been opened for me, quicker. I should say it that way. But, cause

some bands that go in in front of me, not only me, anybody else. They had trouble with them in some spots. So, they put thumbs down on black bands in some places cause maybe somebody got out of line somewhere.
So, the next band, they wouldn't let one come in for awhile. I didn't know too much about it, you know. I think, and I don't know what band it is now. I thought I knew. But, I'm not sure.

What, what kinds of things that come through your mind that might have happened, say, if you had been a white band leader, that didn't happen because of the social circumstance? Of some of the doors that might have been opened, what might some of these be?

Well, maybe I could have got in some of the hotels much quicker, which they came along earlier. And maybe, I don't, you know, it was like, well, just say close like Harry James and myself together. Maybe I could have had a spot in the movies quicker before Harry did, you

know, if I had a been white. You know? MR. GOINES: Right. Cause, then I made a movie. Harry came, he was with Goodman. At the time, they used to come by there to see me a lot. But, I'm just sad that maybe I could have moved that way a little quicker. I'm just pulling out a name. It could have been anybody else, you know.
How do you think things are today in conjunction with that? I mean, do you think they are better, or the same, or slightly better? Greatly better?

I'd say they are better. If you have it, and if the door's open for you to do that, you can go on in there. It is no trouble. You know, I don't want to say no trouble. If they got, if the door's opened and you've got something that they want, they don't pay you no mind. Go right on in.
